{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

df_dedup = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patients: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(duplicates)}")
print(f"Rows after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {missing_baseline}")

# Confirm the assumption about assay_batch
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")
print(f"Batch B values (before correction): {df[df['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final'].describe()}")"}
